description: Defines the InterfaceFactoryImpl class implementing the mojom::InterfaceFactory interface for media components, including creation of decoders, renderers, and CDM, with dependencies on Mojo IPC and media build flags.

classes.name: InterfaceFactoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the mojom::InterfaceFactory interface, responsible for creating media components like decoders, renderers, and CDMs, managing Mojo IPC bindings, and handling object lifecycle.

methods.name: CreateAudioDecoder
methods.description: Creates an audio decoder and binds it to the provided receiver.

methods.name: CreateVideoDecoder
methods.description: Creates a video decoder and binds it to the provided receiver, with optional remote for stable video decoder.

methods.name: CreateAudioEncoder
methods.description: Creates an audio encoder and binds it to the provided receiver.

methods.name: CreateDefaultRenderer
methods.description: Creates a default renderer with specified audio device ID.

methods.name: CreateCastRenderer
methods.description: Creates a cast renderer with specified overlay plane ID (conditional on build flag).

methods.name: CreateMediaPlayerRenderer
methods.description: Creates a media player renderer with client extension remote (Android-specific).

methods.name: CreateFlingingRenderer
methods.description: Creates a flinging renderer with presentation ID (Android-specific).

methods.name: CreateMediaFoundationRenderer
methods.description: Creates a Media Foundation renderer with media log and extension receivers (Windows-specific).

methods.name: CreateCdm
methods.description: Creates a Content Decryption Module (CDM) with specified configuration.

methods.name: OnDestroyPending
methods.description: Handles deferred destruction of the factory object.
